idea: How to maintain a home water system
title: Simple Daily Habits for Healthy Home Plumbing
description: A reliable water system starts with small, consistent habits around your home. Every few months, take a moment to inspect exposed pipes under sinks and near appliances for slow drips or subtle corrosion. Test your main water shutoff valve twice a year to ensure it turns smoothly in case of an emergency. Flushing your water heater annually removes sediment buildup, extending its overall lifespan and maintaining steady water pressure. Lastly, check your home water pressure with an easy-to-use gauge to keep it safely between 40 and 60 PSI. A few simple checks today can prevent costly plumbing emergencies tomorrow.
